record.text:
New Kirby game and foldable iPhone in the same day 😱

The Kirby game looks really hype 🩷🤩

But I never understood what’s with all the buzz these days about foldable phones. 🤷‍♀️ Never seen someone use them. I guess they’re for people who are nostalgic for flip phones but also love a smartphone?
Apple unveiled a foldable iPhone. But all the girlies really want is the clamshell reader from IT FOLLOWS.

record.text:
I have a foldable phone and it is great for two reasons: 
1. Fits in my pocket
2. Makes people go "holy crap your phone folds"

Neither of these features will be available on the new foldable iPhone.
The foldable iPhone is definitely ‘think different’, errrrr . The good news about Apple is that they have enough cash to make dumb products until science can resurrect Steve.
